description.value: The study investigated neural correlates of activities of daily living in frontotemporal dementia and compared them with Alzheimer disease and healthy controls using voxel-based morphometry.

spans.text: This study set out to explore the neural correlates of ADLs in a large sample of patients with FTD in comparison to AD.

description.value: An observational cross-sectional study in which participants with frontotemporal dementia, Alzheimer disease, and healthy controls underwent behavioral assessments and magnetic resonance imaging within 3 months.

spans.text: All participants underwent an ADL assessment, general cognitive assessment, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) within 3 months of ADL assessment.
